replies.author: Awarrior
replies.body:
@Slicorn: Fences are not laggy for me on Singleplayer, at all, I dont know why it would lag on a server

No, it wont feel cramped as there are loads of platforms and many differents ways to go, For exemple the bridge under the middle bridge that allows you to get under the map and sort of parkour and pvp

I'd rather go for maps that are smaller with many levels than for maps that have one level and that are pretty huge...
